pr_title: Add shutter tilt support for Shelly Wave Shutter QNSH-001P10
pr_body:
<!--

## Proposed change
<!--
  Describe the big picture of your changes here to communicate to the
  maintainers why we should accept this pull request. If it fixes a bug
  or resolves a feature request, be sure to link to that issue in the
  additional information section.
-->
Adds support for correct detection of tilt functionality for venetian blinds with Shelly Wave Shutter QNSH-001P10. The QNSH-001P10 reports two multilevel switches, one for shutter and one for tilt functionality. Up to now these were added as two shutter devices in Home Assistant. With this change it is detected whether the QNSH-001P10 is configured in venetian blinds mode and both multilevel switches are combined into one device with tilt functionality in Home Assistant.
The second multilevel switch will be added as disabled by default as it either is combined within the first device or should not have any functionality for shutter devices.

### The problem

I have integrated a shelly wave shutter with Venetian Mode support. In Home Assistant Venetian Tilt is showing as a separate entity and not as a service on the first entity of the shutter. It´s the same problem as before with the Fibaro Shutter 3. 

https://github.com/home-assistant/core/pull/96283

Is it possible to modify the discovery from Z-Wave JS to include the Venetian Tilt in the main entity from the shutter. 
On the shelly wave shutter the tilt values are stored also on the node 2.

Hey @blob810, thank you for fixing this issue! Do you know when/if this is already available? I currently have around a dozen of these Shelly’s running and still the second cover entity for tilting the covers.
I have the latest versions of everything.

Do I need to do some kind of migration for existing Shelly’s or wait for an update?

Its merged in the dev branch from home assistant core but not yet in a current release. I think it will be live in the next major release in June. If you can't wait, you can copy the zware_js folder from components and paste it in our custom_components folder of your home assistant installation.

Thanks a lot for this fix! After updating to 2024.06 release i now get the shutter tilt. Still, home asisstant shows me a second tilt only shutter. Is this intended? 
![image](https://github.com/home-assistant/core/assets/6793480/a32eab44-5db9-44b3-a22e-3ae4daf160e4)

It´s because the device was added before the update to your zwave network. You can try to reinterview the shelly in the settings of zwave or try to remove the device from your network and add it again. Or just deactivate the second entity by your self in the settings of the entity.
